scenarios.name: Retain staged command display options when switching targets

background_steps.name: the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part is active in the MCAD Software
ribbon customization is open with "All Commands" selected
the Part | Tools and Part | Manage custom targets are empty
the user adds "2D Sketches" to the Part | Tools target without applying
the user checks Large and Text for that command
the user selects the Part | Manage target
the Part | Manage target list is empty
"2D Sketches" is available in the source list
the user returns to the Part | Tools target
"2D Sketches" remains in the target list
its Large and Text options are checked
the target is marked as changed
